**VI.126–129 set piece (aeneid-041), decided by the run.** *facilis descensus Averno* was built from the Latin alone and rephrased away from the best-known English wordings (no "easy is the descent", no "night and day… open", no "this the task, this the toil"); the three rows are in `new-renderings.md`. Misprint at 6.155 `aspicies. ”Dixit`: should read `aspicies.” Dixit` (closing mark joined to the next word); the mark stands at the head of the unit `Dixit, pressoque obmutuit ore.` in `t`, and `l`/`i` close the Sibyl's speech after `aspicies.` (rule 5b). Scansion to hand-check: 6.119 (`Orpheus` disyllabic by synizesis; flagged by the scanner), 6.114 `invalidus`, 6.164 `Aeoliden`.
